description: Change alerts, notification settings, canaries, public badges, defensive response requests or renewal for an existing Watchtower account. Requires watch:manage and explicit approval for the selected action. Use vulkill_watchtower_read to obtain IDs and check settings, and vulkill_watchtower_enable to enroll or resume. Canary revocation is permanent, publishing a badge exposes the verified hostname, and a test queues a real notification at most once per minute. Queued actions still need local approval. Only the funding owner can pause renewal, which preserves reports and today’s paid coverage.

action.description: Choose one operation and send only its fields. ack: acknowledge an owned alert and cancel its queued escalation. weekly: turn weekly summaries on or off. timezone: change summary scheduling time zone. delay: set the escalation delay. primary: route initial alerts to the owner or an already paired responder. testChannels: queue one test to existing owner channels. createCanary: issue a canary for a covered target. revokeCanary: permanently invalidate one canary. trustPublish: make the verified hostname and monitoring badge public. trustHide: withdraw its public badge. queue: request a predefined defensive action for separate local approval. cancel: cancel a response request without undoing effects already applied. pauseBilling: stop future daily charges for the funding wallet while preserving today’s paid coverage and reports.

consent.description: True only after the account owner explicitly approves the specific change and its effects.

context.description: Required for queue. Use the installed profile’s non-secret local reference, or one IPv4/IPv6 address for block_ip. Never send a credential or a URL.

enabled.description: Required for weekly. False disables summaries and cancels queued summary deliveries.

id.description: For ack use the alert ID from events. For revokeCanary or cancel use the canary or response UUID from protection. For createCanary or queue choose a fresh UUID and reuse it with the same request on retry.

kind.description: Required for createCanary (link or token) or queue (patch_pr, revoke_key or block_ip).

minutes.description: Required for delay. Minutes to wait before escalating an alert to the secondary recipient.

primary.description: Required for primary. oncall requires an existing paired responder.

profile.description: Required for queue. Choose a predefined local response profile name beginning with a lowercase letter, followed by lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

target.description: Required for createCanary, revokeCanary, trustPublish, trustHide, queue and cancel. Use the owned target UUID from overview. Creating, publishing and queueing require current DNS proof and active coverage.

timezone.description: Required for timezone. Use an IANA time zone such as Europe/Istanbul. With weekly it is optional and only fills an unset time zone.

name: vulkill_watchtower_manage

alreadyCreated.description: The matching canary was already issued for this request UUID.

billing.description: Funding state returned by pauseBilling. Inspect state, renewalEnabled and paidToday to confirm the outcome.

hostname.description: Hostname used for the public badge. Null if the hostname was not assigned.

id.description: Identifier for the new canary, queued notification test, or response request.

ok.description: The change was accepted. Delivery tests and responses are asynchronous.

oneTimeValueAvailable.description: The original canary value cannot be retrieved on retry.

slug.description: Public badge record ID returned by trustPublish.

value.description: New canary link or token. Returned only at creation. Treat it as a secret.
